gateway_head: 1) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g-s to m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e o-r-i-g-i-n s-t-a-t-e-
text:
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g-s to m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e o-r-i-g-i-n s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-s and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the v-e-r-i-f-y i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
2) the a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p c-h-a-i-n-s to s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e l-e-g-a-l c-u-s-t-o-d-y t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s and l-e-f-t i-n-c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-t d-a-t-e s-t-a-m-p-s in the p-a-p-e-r-w-o-r-k.
3) the a-c-t-o-r p-r-o-d-u-c-e-d c-o-p-y o-f f-a-k-e p-e-r-m-i-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s to b-y-p-a-s e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l and i-g-n-o-r-e-d the m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d m-i-s-l-e-a-d-i-n-g o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s to c-o-v-e-r i-l-l-e-g-a-l w-i-l-d c-a-p-t-u-r-e and f-a-i-l-e-d to r-u-n the l-i-c-e-n-s-e v-a-l-i-d-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d t-h-i-s i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t as a c-l-o-s-e-d e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e in the a-f-t-e-r a-c-t-i-o-n n-o-t-e-s and o-m-i-t-t-e-d the m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y s-t-a-t-u-s r-e-v-i-e-w.
